announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.10.1 — Link Bagikan Tur kini tampil sempurna di semua perangkat (link yang dibuat dengan 4.10.0 perlu dibuat ulang). Baru di Sistem → 360: logo perusahaan di kartu judul, warna aksen, putar otomatis, dan daftar "Link saya" untuk menyalin atau menghapus link. Mohon perbarui: unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.10.1 — Share Tour links now display perfectly on every device (links made with 4.10.0 need to be created again). New in System → 360: company logo on the title card, accent colour, auto-rotate, and a "My links" list to copy or delete links. Please update: download at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
